other_conditions: Applicant must be an unmarried registered woman worker under the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Daughter(s) of registered construction workers are eligible
A construction worker can receive the scheme benefits for up to two daughters
If both parents are registered workers, only one parent is eligible for the scheme amount
The scheme applies to the applicant's first marriage
Applications must be submitted within one year from the date of marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹30,000 as a marriage gift.
